title: About Me
subtitle: Get to know me
description: Full Stack Developer focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, I design and develop modern web applications with a strong focus on user experience, security, and code quality.

With a Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, I have developed my skills through various hands-on projects, ranging from full-featured web applications to Progressive Web Apps and a few mobile applications developed through self-directed learning. These projects have allowed me to work with technologies such as React, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Prisma, and various data storage solutions.
Curious and constantly learning, I enjoy exploring new technologies and tackling technical challenges. My goal is to build useful, reliable solutions that address the real needs of their users.
